style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, calm muted colors, slightly dim lighting, a faint washi-paper texture, ancient Japan of the Kofun period. The same art style in every episode.
avoid_en: any text, letters, numbers, logos, modern buildings or clothes, Chinese-style clothing, nudity, blood, famous anime or game character designs

kuebiko.desc_en: Kuebiko, an ancient Japanese god of the mountain rice fields who looks like a living straw scarecrow: a thin tall figure wearing a weathered straw raincoat (mino) and a wide worn straw hat over a plain white Kofun-period tunic, both arms held out to the sides, legs like a wooden pole fixed in the soil, a calm wise old face with kind clear eyes

cuts.image: 夕暮れの山あいの小さな田んぼの真ん中に、ひとりで立ち続ける案山子の姿の神、両腕を広げ、穏やかで賢そうな目、遠くに山、画面の真ん中
cuts.image_en: At dusk, in the middle of a small rice paddy in a mountain valley of ancient Japan, a scarecrow-like god stands alone and still with both arms held out, calm wise eyes, mountains far away. The god is in the exact center of the picture.
cuts.en: At dusk, in the middle of a small rice paddy in a mountain valley of ancient Japan, a scarecrow-like god stands alone and still with both arms held out, calm wise eyes, mountains far away. The god is in the exact center of the picture.

cuts.image: 夕暮れの海の波間を、ガガイモの実を割ったような小さな舟が岸へ寄ってくる、舟の上に手のひらほどの小さな神、浜辺に古墳時代の服の神々が並んで見ている、画面の真ん中に舟
cuts.image_en: At dusk, a tiny boat like a split seed pod drifts toward the shore over the waves, carrying a palm-sized tiny god; on the beach several gods in Kofun-period clothing stand watching. The boat is in the center of the picture.
cuts.en: At dusk, a tiny boat like a split seed pod drifts toward the shore over the waves, carrying a palm-sized tiny god; on the beach several gods in Kofun-period clothing stand watching. The boat is in the center of the picture.

cuts.image: 夜の田んぼのあぜ道で、大きなヒキガエルが顔を上げて何かを告げている、月明かり、水面に月、画面の真ん中
cuts.image_en: On a ridge between rice paddies at night, a big toad lifts its head as if telling something, moonlight, the moon reflected on the water. The toad is in the center of the picture.
cuts.en: On a ridge between rice paddies at night, a big toad lifts its head as if telling something, moonlight, the moon reflected on the water. The toad is in the center of the picture.

cuts.image: 秋の夕方の田んぼを背に、案山子の姿の神が口を開いてはっきり答えている上半身、やさしく賢い目、画面の真ん中
cuts.image_en: Against a rice field on an autumn evening, the scarecrow-like god opens his mouth and answers clearly, upper body, gentle wise eyes, in the center of the picture.
cuts.en: Against a rice field on an autumn evening, the scarecrow-like god opens his mouth and answers clearly, upper body, gentle wise eyes, in the center of the picture.

cuts.image: 雨と風で傷んで、わらがほつれた古い案山子が、山あいの棚田にぽつんと立つ、雨上がりの灰色の空、人はいない、画面の真ん中
cuts.image_en: An old scarecrow, worn by rain and wind with its straw coming apart, stands alone in terraced rice fields in a mountain valley under a gray sky after rain. No people. The scarecrow is in the center of the picture.
cuts.en: An old scarecrow, worn by rain and wind with its straw coming apart, stands alone in terraced rice fields in a mountain valley under a gray sky after rain. No people. The scarecrow is in the center of the picture.
